[[Wydd Kindlerun]] is a [[Rider]] [[boss]] that appears in both in the [[The Wilds]] and [[Aurora Glade]] [[mission]]s.

== Missions ==
* [[Maguuma Jungle]]
** {{NPC location|Aurora Glade}} (random spawn, see notes)
** {{NPC location|The Wilds}} (random spawn, see notes)

== Skills ==
(20 [[Water Magic]] in [[Hard mode]])
* {{skill icon|Aura of Restoration}}
* {{skill icon|Glyph of Lesser Energy}}
* {{skill icon|Ice Spikes}}
* {{skill icon|Maelstrom}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Ancient Eye]]

== Notes ==
* In the Aurora Glade mission, Wydd Kindlerun spawns randomly at one of four points.  It shares those spawn points with [[Tree of Vitality]], [[Chott Stormsinger]], and [[Kezra Spindleweb]].
* In the Wilds mission, Wydd Kindlerun spawns randomly at one of four points.  It shares those spawn points with [[Tree of Vitality]], [[Chott Stormsinger]], [[Grook Plugalug]], and [[Grech Trundle]].  As such, there is a 20% chance that this boss may not spawn.
* This boss possesses the skill Maelstrom, which is not available until reaching [[Maguuma Stade]] (an optional [[outpost]]).  Consider capturing it with a [[Signet of Capture]] as it is a useful skill.
